set.body: Acceptance: deterministic synthetic trajectories encode latent fixation, saccade, blink, loss, off-screen, noise, sampling jitter, dropout, and affine clock drift; an evaluator returns per-class sample precision/recall/F1, onset/offset error, duration bias, centre error, event-count bias, and physical peak-velocity error with explicit units and non-empty denominators.
set.title: Build deterministic synthetic trajectories and validation metrics
